reason: We already pay for a chatbot and it's fine, and an AI that clicks and fills forms on our site in front of customers is a risk I don't need this month. I might try the free plan, but I wouldn't start paying within a month.
objection: If the agent does something wrong on our site in front of a customer (wrong item in cart, a form filled badly), it's my brand that takes the hit, and a log after the fact doesn't undo that.
would_change_my_mind: A few real SaaS case studies showing a measured sign-up lift with zero bad actions, plus a read-only mode (answers and pointing only, no actions) that I could run on top of Intercom for a month and check in the A/B report first.
